title: Fraction Word Problems
topic: Addition, Subtraction and Remainder Problems with Fractions
subject: Mathematics

questions.question: Lisa spent 1/4 of her money on food, then 1/3 of the remainder on drinks and the rest on snacks. What fraction of her money was spent on snacks?
questions.explanation: Food = 1/4. Remainder = 1 - 1/4 = 3/4. Drinks = 1/3 x 3/4 = 1/4. Spent on food and drinks = 1/4 + 1/4 = 1/2. Snacks = 1 - 1/2 = 1/2

questions.question: Tom had some marbles. He gave 1/4 of them to Ali and 2/5 of the remainder to Bella. What fraction of his total marbles did he give to Bella?
questions.explanation: After giving 1/4 to Ali, remainder = 3/4. Bella gets 2/5 of 3/4 = 2/5 x 3/4 = 6/20 = 3/10 of the total.

questions.question: What is 3/4 + 5/8?
Siti spent 1/5 of her money on a book and 3/10 of her money on a pen. What fraction of her money did she spend altogether?
Mary had $120. She spent 1/4 on a dress and 1/3 of the remainder on shoes. How much did she spend on shoes?
What is 5/6 - 1/4?
questions.explanation: Find a common denominator of 12. 5/6 = 10/12. 1/4 = 3/12. So 10/12 - 3/12 = 7/12

questions.question: Mr Tan had some oranges. He sold 2/5 of them in the morning and 1/4 of the remainder in the afternoon. What fraction of his oranges was left?
questions.explanation: Sold in morning = 2/5. Remainder = 3/5. Sold in afternoon = 1/4 x 3/5 = 3/20. Left = 3/5 - 3/20 = 12/20 - 3/20 = 9/20

questions.question: Calculate 2 1/3 + 1 3/4.
Jane had $240. She spent 1/3 on food, 1/4 of the remainder on transport, and saved the rest. How much did she save?
What is 4/5 - 2/3?
questions.explanation: Find a common denominator of 15. 4/5 = 12/15. 2/3 = 10/15. So 12/15 - 10/15 = 2/15

questions.question: Da Tong bought 3 3/4 litres of juice. She drank 1/2 litre and gave 1/2 of the remainder to her friend. How many litres of juice did she have left?
questions.explanation: Start: 3 3/4 = 15/4 L. After drank: 15/4 - 1/2 = 13/4 L. Gave 1/2 of remainder, so 1/2 left: 13/4 x 1/2 = 13/8 = 1 5/8 L.

questions.question: Mei Lin had 2 2/3 kg of flour. She used 1/4 of it to bake cookies and 1/3 of the remainder to make cakes. How much flour did she have left?
questions.explanation: Start: 2 2/3 = 8/3 kg. After used 1/4: 8/3 x 3/4 = 2 kg left. After used 1/3 of remainder: 2 x 2/3 = 4/3 = 1 1/3 kg left.

questions.question: A tank contained 4 1/2 litres of water. 1/3 of the water was used to water plants and 1/2 of the remainder was used to clean the floor. How much water was left in the tank?
questions.explanation: Start: 4 1/2 = 9/2 L. After used 1/3: 9/2 x 2/3 = 3 L left. After used 1/2 of remainder: 3 x 1/2 = 1 1/2 L left.

questions.question: Tom had 5 1/4 m of ribbon. He used 2/3 of it to wrap gifts and gave 1/2 of the remainder to his sister. How much ribbon did Tom have left?
questions.explanation: Start: 5 1/4 = 21/4 m. After used 2/3: 21/4 x 1/3 = 7/4 m left. After gave 1/2 of remainder: 7/4 x 1/2 = 7/8 m left.

questions.question: Sarah baked 3 1/2 dozen cupcakes. She sold 2/5 of them in the morning and 1/3 of the remainder in the afternoon. How many dozen cupcakes were left?
questions.explanation: Start: 3 1/2 = 7/2 dozen. After sold 2/5: 7/2 x 3/5 = 21/10 dozen left. After sold 1/3 of remainder: 21/10 x 2/3 = 42/30 = 1 2/5 dozen left.

questions.question: A bottle contained 2 3/4 litres of milk. 1/5 of the milk was used for coffee and 1/2 of the remainder was used for baking. How much milk was left?
questions.explanation: Start: 2 3/4 = 11/4 L. After used 1/5: 11/4 x 4/5 = 11/5 L left. After used 1/2 of remainder: 11/5 x 1/2 = 11/10 L left.

questions.question: Ben had 4 2/3 kg of rice. He cooked 1/4 of it for lunch and stored 2/3 of the remainder in the pantry. How much rice did he have left to use?
questions.explanation: Start: 4 2/3 = 14/3 kg. After cooked 1/4: 14/3 x 3/4 = 14/4 = 7/2 kg left. After stored 2/3 of remainder: 7/2 x 1/3 = 7/6 kg left.

questions.question: A rope was 6 3/5 m long. 1/3 of it was cut for a project and 3/4 of the remainder was used for tying. How much rope was left?
questions.explanation: Start: 6 3/5 = 33/5 m. After cut 1/3: 33/5 x 2/3 = 22/5 m left. After used 3/4 of remainder: 22/5 x 1/4 = 22/20 = 11/10 m left.

questions.question: Lisa had 3 3/8 litres of paint. She used 1/3 of it for the walls and 1/2 of the remainder for the ceiling. How much paint did she have left?
questions.explanation: Start: 3 3/8 = 27/8 L. After used 1/3: 27/8 x 2/3 = 18/8 L left. After used 1/2 of remainder: 18/8 x 1/2 = 18/16 = 9/8 L left.

questions.question: A jar contained 5 1/2 kg of sugar. 2/5 of the sugar was used for making jam and 1/3 of the remainder was used for baking. How much sugar was left?
questions.explanation: Start: 5 1/2 = 11/2 kg. After used 2/5: 11/2 x 3/5 = 33/10 kg left. After used 1/3 of remainder: 33/10 x 2/3 = 66/30 = 11/5 = 2 1/5 kg left.
